subject: E-4355: crash on launch on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is PixelForge 6.0.7, macOS 15.3. Starting the weekend, the moment I log in a dialog reads 'E-4355: application crashed on launch'.

Changing the display scaling to 150 percent is when it began. Restoring 100 percent scaling makes the app open again.

Before writing in I tried reebooting the router; same eror afterwards.

Regards, Luca Moretti, Brightwater Clinics
